verdict.rationale: Users can delete individual codes and choose to use the app without a Google account (avoiding cloud retention), giving some control over stored data (google-authenticator-docs-2, google-authenticator-docs-8, google-authenticator-docs-14). However, community reports describe real limitations: app data historically excluded from device backups, no simple text export, and codes tied to a Google Account that can be lost entirely if the account is banned or deleted (google-authenticator-comm-6, google-authenticator-comm-7, google-authenticator-comm-8, google-authenticator-comm-17). Missing for 10: documented account-level data deletion/export controls, first-party statement on retention policy for synced codes, and resolution of community-reported backup/export gaps.
